selection.method: Uniform without replacement over saved expert transitions; fixed RNG20260908, identical states for every checkpoint/hybrid. Not phase-balanced and not training replay.

entropy_method.conditional_policy: tanh(Normal(mean,std)), independent-noise one-step conditional density; cached collector temporal dependence not included.

gradient_protocol: Existing actor_gradient_metrics: cloned actor training=True on fixed obs+next_obs batch1024, critic training=False,3 shared RNG repetitions; raw unpreconditioned parameter gradients, not actual replay batch/Adam/AMP/post-step unit normalization.
counterfactual_protocol: Inference-only actor hybrids: current parameters with initial running BN, initial parameters with current running BN. BN affine weight/bias count as parameters. Descriptive mechanism decomposition; not alternate training or causal effect estimates.
limits: Single fixed task/expert state distribution; not full rollout retention, learning, or true-Q calibration.
Inference action differences can be hidden by tanh saturation; both pre-tanh and post-tanh changes reported.
Entropy gradient dominance on this fixed expert batch does not prove the historical optimizer step or entropy was the sole cause of failure.
Training-mode metrics change only a disposable clone; no live checkpoint, simulator, replay or optimizer is changed.
Final checkpoint deliberately omitted from early-onset audit; update2000/4000 included because already available.
